subject: SIG activation — evidence owners, CAIQ preference, and target deadlines
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.inference>
To: Felix Martinez <felix.martinez@healthbanner.com>, Claire Zhou <claire@healthbanner.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 31 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG activation — evidence owners, CAIQ preference, and target deadlines

Thanks again for the demo earlier today — appreciate the thoughtful questions. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment for procurement/security: 

- Scope recap: HealthBanner is evaluating Redwood for production inference (US-region, HIPAA scope called out).
- Compliance posture (what we discussed on the call): SOC 2 Type II is in progress at Redwood (Type II target: Mar 2027); we can provide a bridge summary and a redacted pen-test summary while the Type II completes.

Recommendation and ask: based on the call, it sounds like your security team prefers the CAIQ (full) questionnaire. We typically run a SIG/CAIQ campaign for customers in regulated verticals and map evidence ownership per-question to accelerate procurement. I attached our initial SIG template (RBW-SIG-Init-Template.xlsx) — it's a lightweight mapping we fill out with owners and expected delivery dates.

Please confirm the following so we can whip up a completed bundle for your team: 
1) Confirm scope: do you want the questionnaire answered for production only, or production + staging/dev?
2) Can you confirm your evidence owners on your side (name + email) — procurement or security?
3) Any non-standard requirements: specific KMS/HSM proof, data residency controls, or additional encryption attestations beyond HIPAA/GDPR?
4) Target deadline from your procurement side for a completed questionnaire (you mentioned early November on the call — please confirm exact date).

Proposed Redwood owners: Lauren Bishop (security intake & evidence coordination) and Jordan Blake (engineering evidence + network diagrams). If those work, we'll map per-question owners and target a delivery milestone.

Next steps I propose: I fill out the CAIQ-lite mapping and return a prefilled spreadsheet for your security team to review by EOD Monday. If you confirm owners and deadline now I’ll aim for a draft earlier.

Attachments: RBW-SIG-Init-Template.xlsx (questionnaire + owner mapping)

Best,
Priyom
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri yom@redwood.inference
From: Felix Martinez <felix.martinez@healthbanner.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.inference>
Cc: Claire Zhou <claire@healthbanner.com>
Date: Sat, 01 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG activation — evidence owners, CAIQ preference, and target deadlines

Thanks, Priyom — helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Scope: We need the questionnaire filled out for production and pre-production (staging). Both environments will host PHI during testing, so HIPAA controls must be explicit.
- SOC 2: Our legal/procurement expects a SOC 2 Type II report; you mentioned Red wood is in progress. Can you confirm whether you can provide an interim report or a bridge letter and a recent penetration test summary?
- CAIQ: Yes, please prioritize the CAIQ full form — our security team prefers the more exhaustive mapping.
- Deadline: Procurement would like a completed QA bundle by 2026-11-15. That’s the date the vendor committee meets; if we don't have materials by then it stalls.

Also: we have a dedicated security contact who will own evidence on our side — Claire Zhou (cc'd). Claire, will you be the owner for access to any additional documentation?

Can you also confirm whether Redwood offers a Private deployment/VPC option (we may need it for a subset of traffic)? If so, can you include hosting/residency details in the CAIQ answers?

Thanks — Felix
Felix Martinez
Director, Procurement | HealthBanner
felix.martinez@healthbanner.com
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.inference>
To: Felix Martinez <felix.martinez@healthbanner.com>, Claire Zhou <claire@healthbanner.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference>
Date: Sat, 01 Nov 2026 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG activation — evidence owners, CAIQ preference, and target deadlines

Appreciate the quick clarifications, Felix — super helpful. Short answers below and an updated plan: 

1) Scope: confirmed — we’ll prepare CAIQ responses for production + staging. I’ll mark questions that differ by environment where relevant.
2) SOC 2 / pen test: we will provide a SOC 2 bridge letter and our most recent penetration test summary (redacted as needed) while the Type II completes in March. I’ll attach the pen-test executive summary to the CAIQ bundle; legal can provide redaction guidance.
3) Private deployment: yes — Redwood offers private deployment (VPC + customer-managed networking) and Dedicated capacity options. I’ll include hosting/residency and KMS integration notes in the answers.
4) Deadline: we’ll aim to deliver the prefilled CAIQ bundle by 2026-11-12 to give your procurement two business days for final review ahead of the committee on 2026-11-15. If that works on your side please confirm.

Action items (Redwood):
- Lauren to coordinate evidence collection and sign-off (owner: Lauren Bishop).
- Jordan to pull KMS diagram, network diagram, and pen-test summary (owner: Jordan Blake).
- I will prefill the CAIQ mapping and label per-question owners and expected delivery dates; attach updated template (RBW-SIG-Init-Template-v2.xlsx).

Action items (HealthBanner):
- Confirm per-question owners (Claire please confirm).
- Confirm whether procurement wants a vendor security interview before the committee.

I’ll get the draft back to you Monday morning. If you need a tighter turnaround, we can prioritize the highest-risk controls first (HIPAA encryption, access controls, and data residency).

Attachments: RBW-SIG-Init-Template-v2.xlsx

Best,
Priyom
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.inference>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG activation — evidence owners, CAIQ preference, and target deadlines

Looping Jordan in to own the engineering evidence pack and pull the following:
- Redacted pen-test executive summary (Jordan to check what can be shared)
- KMS diagram + HSM integration notes
- Network diagram for VPC/Dedicated option

Jordan — can you target a first-pass evidence bundle by EOD Tuesday (2026-11-03)? I’ll coordinate legal sign-off and packaging for Felix's procurement timeline. Priyom — if HealthBanner confirms Claire as their owner and the 11/15 committee date, we’ll treat 11/12 delivery as the internal hard deadline.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Security Intake Lead | Redwood Inference
